details: Worked on API-driven integration project for Sohar International bank connecting Core Banking Systems, CBO, and
partner platforms for rent collection
Gathered and analyzed requirements for APIs including account enquiry, authentication, UI design, mandate
execution, debit/ credit posting, and status callbacks.
Performed interface analysis and data mapping, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across systems.
Acted as a liaison between business, product, and development teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high- •
availability integrations.
Improved turnaround time for mandate execution and status updates by 30–40% through streamlined API flows.
Configured Postman requests for seamless integration and testing of web services, ensuring optimal performance and
reliability.
Supported development processes, monitored deployments, and ensured smooth functionality post-implementation.
Managed integrations over APIs and web services, enabling efficient communication and data exchange between
systems.

projects.name: Term deposit subscription
details: Problem Statement - There has been a revenue decline for the bank and they would like to know what actions to take.
After investigation, it was found out that the root cause is that customers are not depositing as frequently as before.
Knowing that term deposits allow banks to hold onto a deposit for a specific amount of time, so banks can invest in
higher-gain financial products to make a profit. As a result, the bank would like to identify existing customers who have a
higher chance to subscribe for a term deposit and focus marketing efforts on such customers. Workflow- Problem
identification, Requirement elicitation, documentation, database, export data from database to CSV format to get data
insights, dashboarding, architecture, development, testing, and integration to the system. Tools- Google Docs, SQL,
Power BI, Python.
